# jumpcloud_software_app (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud software application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_software_app" "chrome" {
  display_name = "Google Chrome"

  settings = jsonencode({
    packageId = "com.google.chrome"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the software application.

### Optional

- `settings` (String) JSON-encoded settings for the software application. Structure depends on the application type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the software application.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_software_app.example <software-app-id>
```
